prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: The person's right hand is extended toward the scanner but remains visibly separated from the object with a clear gap.
Right hand is hovering/approaching with a visible gap from the scanner object.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but remains visibly separated with a clear gap; no touch or grasp is visible.
The right hand is reaching toward the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear touch.
The right hand is reaching toward the scanner but remains visibly separated with a gap; no clear touch or grasp.
The person's right hand/fingers visibly overlap and touch the pink scanner near its upper side with no clear gap.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but a visible gap remains; no clear physical touch.
Right hand is close to the scanner but no clear visible touch or overlap; contact is ambiguous.
Right hand is very close to the scanner, but clear physical touching or grasping is not visible; contact is ambiguous.
Right hand is reaching near the scanner, but visible contact/overlap is not clearly shown.
The person's right fingertips visibly overlap and touch the top of the pink scanner with no gap.
